summary: Optimi Health Corp. filed a Form 6-K with a press release announcing completion of a GMP production run of 5mg psilocybin capsules for treatment-resistant depression in Australia, with additional product for planned US and European clinical trials. No terms regarding price, premium, or transaction structure are provided. The filing reports ordinary business operations — commercial production and supply — not a special situation. No board recommendation, advisor, or deal mechanics are noted. Watch for regulatory approvals and export orders, but there is no risk-arb angle.
